liveAsr.transcript: 项目评审之后，之处理P零和P一问题。外部报告里不能包含薪资数据。邮件只能生成草稿，不要自动发送。如果负责人缺失，必须标记为需要确认。只有存在截止日期时，才创建日历站位。

recoveryTests.dualTunnelGateway: Radeon Cloud rc-tunnel is the primary origin and Cloudflare Quick Tunnel is the fallback origin. The stable Pages response exposes x-rvsf-origin-kind without revealing credentials. Stopping rc-tunnel produced three consecutive HTTP 200 responses marked quick-tunnel; Supervisor re-exposed a new rc domain, the registrar updated KV, and the response returned to HTTP 200 marked rc-tunnel. Stopping Quick Tunnel separately left stable Pages health at HTTP 200 through rc-tunnel.
recoveryTests.dependencyFailureDetection: ASR termination produced public HTTP 503 with asr=unavailable
recoveryTests.dependencyAutoRestart: supervisord restored ASR and public HTTP 200 in about 20 seconds
recoveryTests.quickTunnelRotation: new Quick Tunnel registered and stable Pages health recovered in about 25 seconds
recoveryTests.supervisorMainProcessRecovery: an independent watchdog detected supervisord shutdown, restarted it after three 30-second failures, restored all six managed services, and reached stable public HTTP 200 in about 161 seconds from shutdown
recoveryTests.localExternalMonitor: launchd runs every 300 seconds. Several HTTP 000 probes on 2026-08-03 were isolated to the Mac network or sleep state: the W7900 internal monitor returned healthy every minute during the same interval.
recoveryTests.githubExternalMonitor: GitHub Actions requests four offset checks per hour; actual schedule execution is best-effort. Observed scheduled runs are recorded in GITHUB_SCHEDULED_HEALTH_SUMMARY.json.
